title: A Localized Core-Tail Fourier-Laguerre Frame Method with Adaptive Frequency Detection for Unbounded-Domain Problems
summary: We propose a localized core--tail Fourier--Laguerre frame method for approximation and model problems on the real line. The domain is decomposed into a finite core and two semi-infinite tails. Local Fourier extension is used in the core to resolve nonperiodic, oscillatory, and locally nonsmooth structures, while modulated Laguerre frames are used in the tails so that the Laguerre functions approximate only slowly varying decaying envelopes.
